sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Is it right?' is a simple yet challenging puzzle game that requires players to match colored tiles in a specific sequence. The game takes place on a grid, with tiles of different colors appearing in a particular order. Your goal is to select the correct tiles, in the correct order, to progress through the levels and unlock new skins. Sounds easy, right? Well, think again. The game's subtle nuances and complexities will keep you on your toes, requiring you to think critically and strategically to succeed.

One of the most unique features of 'Is it right?' is its use of color and logic. Players must use their observation skills to identify patterns and sequences, making connections between seemingly unrelated tiles. As the game progresses, the complexity increases, introducing new tile types, sequences, and challenges that will test your skills to the limit. With each level, the game becomes increasingly difficult, requiring players to adapt and adjust their strategies on the fly.

The game also features a variety of tile types, each with its own unique properties and characteristics. Some tiles may be transparent, allowing you to see the tile beneath, while others may have special powers, such as blocking or reversing the sequence. Mastering these tile types and learning to use them effectively is crucial to success in 'Is it right?'
